fullDescription: A refined, technical SaaS dashboard design system with a 'Tech-blue' aesthetic, utilizing Plus Jakarta Sans for a modern feel. Features an editorial typography approach for labels, high-contrast KPI cards, and a sophisticated three-column layout (Sidebar, Data Grid, and Intelligence Panel). Suitable for HR-tech, CRM, project management, and data-heavy analytics platforms requiring high information density with visual clarity. Key attributes include glassmorphism-lite shadows, bento-grid metrics, and strict uppercase tracking for metadata.

structured.summary: An enterprise-grade, data-driven management interface featuring a slate-and-blue color palette, rounded geometry, and meticulous information hierarchy. The design balances professional utility with aesthetic micro-interactions, using consistent border-radii and elevated shadows to define functional zones.

style.description: The style is defined by a clean, tech-centric palette (#2563EB primary) and a dual-font system pairing 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for UI with 'JetBrains Mono' for technical data. Layouts use subtle border styling (#E2E8F0) and a soft 'card-shadow' (0 4px 20px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)) to create depth without clutter. High-density information is managed through 10px-11px uppercase labels with 'tracking-widest' letter spacing, while interactive states feature smooth 200ms transitions and hover-triggered border color shifts to #93C5FD.
style.prompt:
Create a sophisticated SaaS UI using a 'Slate and Cobalt' theme. 
- **Colors**: Primary: #2563EB (Blue 600); Secondary: #64748B (Slate 500); Backgrounds: #F8FAFC (Body), #FFFFFF (Cards); Accents: #22C55E (Success), #F59E0B (Pending), #EF4444 (Critical).
- **Typography**: Primary Font: 'Plus Jakarta Sans'. Use 18px-20px Bold for page titles, 16px Bold for card titles, 14px Medium for body text, and 10px-11px Bold Uppercase with 0.1em tracking for category labels. Technical values should use 'JetBrains Mono'.
- **Borders & Shadows**: All containers use 'rounded-2xl' (16px) or 'rounded-xl' (12px). Borders are 1px solid #E2E8F0. Apply a custom shadow: box-shadow: 0 4px 20px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05).
- **Animations**: CSS transitions for all hover states (border-color, transform, background-color) set to 150ms-250ms ease-in-out.

layout_and_structure.description: A fixed-height, overflow-hidden three-column layout designed for desktop efficiency. Left sidebar for navigation, central scrollable area for primary content/lists, and a right panel for contextual intelligence and KPIs.

prompts.partPt: Left Menu do Topo Menu Lateral
prompts.prompt: Width: 288px (w-72). Border-right: 1px #E2E8F0. Top section: Logo (40x40px) with brand title and 10px uppercase tagline. Middle section: Nav links with 18px icons, 14px medium text, and a blue-tinted active state (#EFF6FF bg, #2563EB text). Bottom section: Profile switcher card with 32px circular avatar and settings icon.

Height: 64px (h-16). Flex layout with items-center and justify-between. Left side: Page Title (text-lg bold) followed by a vertical separator (#E2E8F0) and a record count (text-sm medium slate-500). Right side: Button group including a secondary outline button and a primary blue button with icon and shadow-lg shadow-blue-200/50.

Horizontal layout, 16px padding (p-4). Background: White. Border: 1px #E2E8F0. Search input: flex-1, icon-prefix, bg-slate-50, 12px rounded-xl. Select dropdowns: min-width 140px, bold 14px text. Date picker: bg-slate-50, icon-prefix. All inputs must share a consistent height of 42px (py-2.5).

2-column grid (xl:grid-cols-2) with 24px gap (gap-6). Each card: p-6 padding, 16px rounded-2xl, card-shadow. Card Header: 48px avatar, title, subtitle, and top-right status badge (px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-[10px]). Card Body: 2-column info grid with bg-slate-50 rounded-lg backgrounds. Card Footer: Multi-line text area with italics and 'line-clamp-2' logic for long notes.

Width: 320px (w-80). Section 1: KPI stack featuring a high-contrast 'Hero' card (#2563EB background, white text) with a progress bar and percentage change indicator. Section 2: Progress metric list for individual performance tracking with 4px height progress bars and hover-scale avatars. Section 3: Contextual tip box with #EFF6FF background and lightbulb icon.

special_ui_components.description: A high-impact blue card for primary KPIs.
special_ui_components.prompt: Background #2563EB, Padding 20px (p-5), Rounded 16px (rounded-2xl). Label: text-blue-100, 12px. Value: text-3xl, font-extrabold. Includes a custom progress track: background #60A5FA at 30% opacity, with a white foreground bar. Bottom row: flex items-center gap-1, text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest.

special_ui_components.description: Compact, color-coded labels for workflow status.
special_ui_components.prompt: Text: 10px bold, uppercase. Padding: px-3, py-1. Rounded: Full. Success: bg-green-50, text-green-700, border-green-100. Pending: bg-amber-50, text-amber-700, border-amber-100. Failure: bg-red-50, text-red-700, border-red-100.

Row: Flex items-center, gap-12px. Avatar: 32x32px circle, bg-slate-100, text-slate-600. Bar: 4px height, bg-slate-100 background. Fill: Primary blue (#2563EB) with width determined by data. Transition: width 1000ms ease-out on load.
